packageRules.description: TODO(AAV-1354): TypeScript majors cannot go green today, and `typescript`'s `latest` dist-tag is already 7.0.2, so Renovate re-opens a PR that can never pass. Two independent blockers, both verified 2026-11-11: (1) every typescript-eslint release, 8.72.2 included, peers `typescript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0`, so `npm install` fails with ERESOLVE; (2) TS 7 removed `moduleResolution: "node"` outright (TS5108, hard error in 4 tsconfigs) where TS 6 only deprecates it (TS5107, silenceable with `ignoreDeprecations`). Disabled at the major level, not per-version, because the next major would hit the same peer wall. Remove this rule once typescript-eslint's peer range covers TS 7.

TODO(AAV-1301): eslint 10 cannot install on the backend either, for the same upstream reason as the frontend ceiling: eslint-plugin-import@2.32.0 peers `^2 || ^3 || ... || ^9` with no `^10`, so a strict `npm ci` fails with ERESOLVE. typescript-eslint@8.72.1 and eslint-plugin-react-hooks already allow `^10`, so eslint-plugin-import is the only blocker. Verified 2026-11-11 against the failing `renovate/major-eslint-monorepo` PR #229 (`peerOptional eslint@^10.0.0 from @eslint/js@10.0.1` while the lockfile still resolves eslint 9.39.5). Both packages are capped together because the pair must move as one: capping only `@eslint/js` leaves `eslint` itself free to jump. `eslint` 9.x minor/patch keep flowing. Drop this rule once eslint-plugin-import's peer range covers eslint 10.

TODO(AAV-1359): `@aave/client` is the V3 data path and cannot move to v7 — v7 deleted `markets()` and did not replace V3 with anything equivalent. Verified 2026-11-11 by querying the live API through both SDKs: v7's `chains()` knows 4 chains (1, 5042, 8453, 43114) where v0.12 knows 21, and v7's `reserves([137, 10, 42161])` returns 0 rows because Polygon/Optimism/Arbitrum are V3-only. The 122 reserves v7 does return are all V4 hub/spoke (`asset.hub`, `HubAssetSettings`, no aToken/vToken), while v0.12 still serves 24 V3 markets — AaveV3Polygon alone has 21 supply reserves. So the data is not gone from the API; v7's typed surface dropped it. Matched with `matchDepNames` on purpose: `@aave/client-v4` is an npm alias of the same package at ^7 and must keep updating. Drop this rule once a release exposes the V3 markets again.
Automerge only where the 7-day cool-down can be enforced: Renovate has no release timestamp for these update types, so it cannot check the release age and must not merge them unattended.
